title: Get this package: a world that needs a non-PyPI package opens a wizard
covers: Needs a package state, PackageSourceDialog wizard up to the install choice
context: A world can need a Python package that is not on PyPI. Chrono Trigger Rando-Dalton Imperial needs ctrando. Add ends with the card state Needs a package Archipelia cannot install and the button Get this package. The wizard warns first, lists ranked GitHub projects, asks you to trust one, and shows what it found. This test stops before anything installs.
changed: packages/design PackageSourceDialog: the wizard steps Why you are asked, Choose the source, What we found, Choose how

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

setup.label: network
setup.text: Needed. The project suggestions come from GitHub. If GitHub asks Archipelia to wait, a sentence with a time shows. That is not a failure: try again later.

setup.label: engine
setup.text: Ready (the Engine page under App shows Ready).

setup.label: world
setup.text: Chrono Trigger Rando-Dalton Imperial, a world of the tab Archipelago index. It needs the package ctrando, which is not on PyPI.

setup.label: safety
setup.text: Do not install anything in this test. Installing runs third party code on your PC.

steps: Open Library, Games, tab Archipelago index. Search Chrono Trigger Rando-Dalton Imperial and press Add. The card ends with Needs a package Archipelia cannot install, not a red Failed, and its first button is Get this package.

Press the title: a yellow box says the world needs ctrando. Close the dialog and press Get this package. A wizard titled Get the package ctrando opens on Why you are asked. It warns that installing runs code from the internet. Press Next.
Choose the source: the text Looking for ctrando on GitHub shows, then project cards best first, each with name, description, stars, Updated, Created, Open on GitHub and Use this one.
Read the badges: Contains ctrando, or Does not contain ctrando (Use this one is greyed out), Linked by this world, From the world's Warnings: Archived, New project, Few stars
Press Open on GitHub on one card: the repository opens in your browser.
Under Not here? Paste a GitHub link type a nonsense link and press Look it up. A sentence says Archipelia could not find that repository, and the list stays.

Press Use this one on a card that contains ctrando, then Next. It refuses with Confirm that you trust it first. Tick I trust and the repository name (or type the name when the card has warnings) and press Next.

What we found says whether a ready-made build exists, with a version and date, or No ready-made build for this engine. A line starting Good news means the project is on PyPI under another name. Do not choose an install route.

If Build it from its source code is offered, pick it, Next, then I will do it mys A command box with a copy button shows (and steps A C compiler and Git for C sources At Check again press once: Archipelia still cannot find ctrando.
Press Cancel. The wizard closes, the card still reads Needs a package Archipelia cannot install, and the world is not under Installed.
pass: Add ends with the card state Needs a package Archipelia cannot install and the button Get this package, with a plain sentence in the details.
The wizard warns first. Projects come best first with clear badges, and a project that does not contain ctrando cannot be used.
Next needs the trust tick or the typed name. What we found shows the ready-made build or its absence.
Check again says in a sentence that the package is still missing. Nothing installs until you press an install button, and Cancel leaves the card unchanged.
fail: Add shows a code, a stack or a blank line, or the card shows Failed instead of the new state.
The wizard opens without the warning, or something installs before you trust a project and choose an install route.
A project that does not contain ctrando can be used, or Next works without the tick or the typed name.
The wizard stays empty, or an error shows with no sentence. (A GitHub wait sentence with a time is not a failure.)
notes: The ready-made build comes from the GitHub releases of the project. When GitHub published no checksum, you must type the repository name to use it.
Building from source is the next test. It runs the project code and is optional.
If the index fixed Chrono Trigger Rando-Dalton Imperial and it installs normally, remove it again and say so in your note.
